lead.title: Open-source UEFI tool lifts Nvidia's half-speed tensor cap on RTX 20/30/40 cards
lead.summary: The nv-uefi-unlocker project boots from a USB stick before the Nvidia driver loads and removes the FP16 tensor half-rate limiter on RTX 20, 30 and 40-series desktop and laptop GPUs, lifting matrix-math throughput by a reported 65-91% without VBIOS flashing or patched drivers. That is a measurable, free speedup for anyone running quantized LLMs on last-gen GeForce cards. Blackwell RTX 50-series cards remain unsupported, and the unlock must be reapplied after every cold boot.

top_stories.title: 1bit-MONSTER engine v2026.44 boots ternary-model inference on AMD Strix Halo
top_stories.summary: First signed 2.3 GiB image boots Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 systems into a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible Lemonade Server, running Qwen3.8, ZAYA1, Ternary-Bonsai, BitNet b1.58 and gpt-oss-20b on the Radeon 8060S iGPU via custom HIP kernels, with 89.29 tok/s reported on the XDNA 2 NPU.

top_stories.title: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next hits 900 t/s prefill on 8 GB VRAM with CPU offload
top_stories.summary: A reproducible Strata setup runs Qwen 3.8 Flash Next Q2 on an RTX 5060 Laptop (8 GB VRAM, 32 GB RAM) at 900 t/s PP / 30 t/s TG, with separate Chat and Agentic configs and better results than larger Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B setups.

top_stories.title: Altman meets Samsung leadership as the memory crunch inflates local-rig prices
top_stories.summary: OpenAI's CEO met roughly 50 senior Samsung executives in Yongin amid a DRAM/HBM shortage that TrendForce sees running 1-2% short of demand in 2026 and worsening in 2027; Samsung and SK hynix control about 83% of HBM revenue, keeping RAM and VRAM prices high for local-AI builders.

top_stories.title: LattePanda Sigma 2 packs Panther Lake, 64GB LPDDR5X and a preloaded Qwen3.6 stack
top_stories.summary: The new single-board server pairs an Intel Core Ultra X7 358H (122 TOPS INT8 Arc B390 + 50-TOPS NPU) with 64GB LPDDR5X-8533, up to 59GB allocatable to graphics — enough for quantized ~35B MoE models — and ships with Ubuntu, OpenVINO Model Server and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B INT4 preloaded at $2,599 preorder.

items.title: Atomic Chat ships measured GGUF quants of Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, the Qwen3.6-derived block-diffusion MoE
items.summary: Importance-matrix builds of DiffuSpace's Apache-2.0 block-diffusion model (~3B active parameters, 128K context) range from 13.7 GB IQ2_S to 36.9 GB Q8_0, each measured for KL divergence against BF16; the clover_moe architecture still needs llama.cpp built from unmerged PR #31306.

items.title: HoshiuZ releases a fully reconstructed LLaVA-NeXT-8B-Unlearned checkpoint for unlearning research
items.summary: A complete BF16 checkpoint merges a pinned llama3-llava-next-8b base with a sparse WMDP-targeted unlearning overlay into one ready-to-run release, with the prior revision preserved for reproducibility.

items.title: Infernix ships Qwen3.8-Flash-Next optimizations and a beta WebUI launcher
items.summary: The C++/CUDA single-GPU engine adds calibrated automatic speculative decoding, a reproducible lossless mode and a beta WebUI for downloads and test chats on RTX 5090 (Windows and Linux); performance claims versus Strata and Basalt are self-reported.

items.title: Frontier UI brings ChatGPT-style generative UI to Open WebUI
items.summary: A single MIT-licensed Python file turns tool-calling model output into rich visual answers — street-level maps, photo galleries, live charts and real Office/PDF exports — rendered server-side from one small JSON spec, with no extra inference services or API keys.

items.title: Bowerbird is an open-source, local-first NotebookLM alternative for any model
items.summary: A research notebook that answers questions about your own PDFs and books with checked, verifiable quotes, working with any model rather than a hosted service.

items.title: llama.cpp b12032 adds OpenCL IQ3 quantization kernels and a Hexagon DMA fix
items.summary: The Nov 1 daily-build run brings initial IQ3 support for OpenCL (iq3_s/iq3_xxs on Adreno and others), a Hexagon DMA stride fix and SYCL PkgConfig build improvements.

items.title: Mintu v0.2.1: privacy-first llama.cpp desktop companion lands on macOS
items.summary: The Tauri 2 + Rust Dynamic Island companion adds multi-monitor support, an inline scratchpad, a native audio engine and a universal macOS package (Apple Silicon and Intel), with zero telemetry and offline-first local SQLite persistence.

items.title: Ziskind: MSI RTX Spark N1X laptop runs Linux at a quarter of its plugged-in speed
items.summary: Measured 61 tok/s on native Linux unplugged versus 15 tok/s plugged in (missing NVIDIA Platform Controllers and Framework support), while WSL2 matched Windows at ~65 tok/s on a 120B GPTQ workload; NVIDIA says optimized quantized Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe builds for local execution are coming.

items.title: Nace AI releases Drex Max v1, a 27B multimodal model tuned for Apple Silicon
items.summary: Open weights for a 27B multimodal decision model (reported eval score 67.52) designed to run entirely on Apple Silicon unified memory, targeting 32GB+ Macs without multi-GPU setups.

items.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt on the ASUS ProArt P16: fast for bounded tasks, shaky on distractors
items.summary: Hands-on testing with full 89-layer GPU offload via ARM64 CUDA llama.cpp showed ~23-24 tok/s generation and sub-second first-token latency on short structured tasks, but failed distractor-heavy retrieval where cloud models passed.
